name: Recursive Teaching Dimension of Blockwise-Addressing
proof: For $f_i$, the labeled pair $(z,0),(x_i,1)$ distinguishes it from every $f_j$ and $g_j$; symmetrically $(z,1),(y_i,1)$ teaches $g_i$.  The same bound holds in every subfamily, so $RTD\le2$.  Conversely, in the full class no one-coordinate sample identifies a concept: at $z$ there are many concepts with each label; at a private coordinate a concept from the opposite family can match; and at a block coordinate every bit occurs for many members of the same family.  Thus $TS_{\min}\ge2$, hence $RTD\ge2$.
